# Eurasia Journal of Mathematics, Science and Technology Education

> A peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal publishing STEM education research with international editorial leadership and indexing in major databases.

EJMSTE is an international journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in mathematics, science, and technology education. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards and is indexed in Scopus, Google Scholar, and other major research databases.

## Key Topics

- STEM education
- Mathematics education
- Science education
- Technology education
- Peer-reviewed research
- Open access publishing
- Computational thinking
- Educational research
- Publication ethics
- Double-blind peer review
- ISSN 1305-8215
- Scopus indexing
- ICT in education
- Manuscript submission
- Journal policies
